description:
Young lady Yeonhwa is obsessed with the desire to kill the Emperor to avenge her father's death. The Emperor is a puppet in the advisers' hands and decides to figure out what's going on. Sudden feelings them put Yeonhwa into a strange situation. Will feelings or vengeance win?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/lotus), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6539143), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/57733484)
